title: There is / There are
objectives: Use there is + singular and there are + plural.
canDo: I can say what exists in a place using there is and there are.

warmUp.title: Há / existe
warmUp.prompt: Em português: "Tem um livro na mesa" / "Há três cadeiras". Em inglês usamos There is / There are.
reflectionQuestions: There is ou There are: two cats?

explanation:
There is + singular: There is a book on the table.
There are + plural: There are three chairs.

Negative: There isn't… / There aren't…
Questions: Is there…? / Are there…?

Use there is/are to introduce what exists — different from have (possession).

grammar.title: There is / There are
grammar.rule: There is + singular noun. There are + plural noun. In questions, invert: Is there a bank near here? Are there any students?

examples.sentence: There is a park near my house.

vocabulary.example: There is a café on this street.
There is a bed in the room.
There is a lamp on the table.
There is a fridge in the kitchen.

sentences: There is a TV in the living room.
There aren't any shops open today.

reading.title: My New Apartment
reading.text: I love my new apartment! There is a big living room with a sofa and a TV. There are two bedrooms. In the kitchen, there is a new fridge and there are many cupboards. There isn't a garden, but there is a small balcony. There aren't any shops in the building, but there are two cafés on my street.

questions.question: What is in the kitchen?
questions.explanation: A new fridge and many cupboards.

questions.question: Are there shops in the building?
questions.explanation: There aren't any shops in the building.

writing.prompt: Describe your home: 5 sentences with there is/are (include one negative).
writing.modelAnswer: There are three rooms in my apartment. There is a small kitchen. There is a sofa in the living room. There aren't any pets. There are two windows in my bedroom.

tutorHints: Contrast there is vs have: There is a cat vs I have a cat.
